invariants.rationale: The method always returns an initialized map, so the result is never null.
All values in the result map are non-null lists.
All HoodieRecord objects in the result can be traced back to the dedupedRecords input list.
For each key in the result map, there exists at least one dedupedRecord that was mapped to it using the partitioner.
Each dedupedRecord appears exactly once across all result map values, indicating no duplication or omission of records.
